steps.text: Set groups to an empty dictionary.
Process each (name, role, score) in candidates. Append (name, score) to groups.setdefault(role, []).
Check whether not (groups). Return [an empty list, an empty list].
Process each values in groups.values(). Call values.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0])).
Set squads to a list of a list of groups[role][i][0] for role in the sorted values of groups for i in range(size).
Set left to the sorted values of (name for values in groups.values() for name, score in values[size:]).
